   143	def exact_keys(value, keys):
   144	    if type(value) is not dict:
   145	        raise Invalid('object type')
   146	    if len(value) != len(keys):
   147	        raise Invalid('object keys')
   148	    for key in keys:
   149	        if key not in value:
   150	            raise Invalid('object keys')
   151	    return value

   154	def canon_name(value):
   155	    """Validate an absolute name and return its canonical (lowercase) form."""
   156	    if type(value) is not str:
   157	        raise Invalid('name type')
   158	    if not value:
   159	        raise Invalid('name empty')
   160	    if value == '.':
   161	        return '.'
   162	    if not value.endswith('.'):
   163	        raise Invalid('relative name')
   164	    wire = 1
   165	    for label in value[:-1].split('.'):
   166	        size = len(label)
   167	        if size == 0 or size > MAX_LABEL:
   168	            raise Invalid('label size')
   169	        if label != '*':
   170	            for char in label:
   171	                if char not in _ASCII_LABEL:
   172	                    raise Invalid('label character')
   173	        wire += size + 1
   174	        if wire > MAX_NAME_WIRE:
   175	            raise Invalid('name wire length')
   176	    return value.lower()
   177

   179	def is_at_or_below(name, origin):
   180	    """Whole-label suffix test; the root contains every name."""
   181	    if origin == '.':
   182	        return True
   183	    if name == '.':
   184	        return False
   185	    return name == origin or name.endswith('.' + origin)
   186	
   187	
   188	def label_count(name):
   189	    if name == '.':
   190	        return 0
   191	    return name[:-1].count('.') + 1
   192	
   193	
   194	def parent_name(name):
   195	    if name == '.':
   196	        return '.'
   197	    return name[name.index('.') + 1:]

   200	# ------------------------------------------------------------ data checks --
   201	
   202	def canon_a_data(value):
   203	    if type(value) is not str:
   204	        raise Invalid('A data type')
   205	    parts = value.split('.')
   206	    if len(parts) != 4:
   207	        raise Invalid('A data shape')
   208	    for part in parts:
   209	        if not part:
   210	            raise Invalid('A data octet')
   211	        if part[0] == '0' and len(part) > 1:
   212	            raise Invalid('A data leading zero')
   213	        for char in part:
   214	            if char < '0' or char > '9':
   215	                raise Invalid('A data digit')
   216	        if int(part) > 255:
   217	            raise Invalid('A data range')
   218	    return value
   219

   221	def canon_aaaa_data(value):
   222	    if type(value) is not str:
   223	        raise Invalid('AAAA data type')
   224	    if '%' in value:
   225	        raise Invalid('AAAA scope')
   226	    try:
   227	        address = ipaddress.IPv6Address(value)
   228	    except Exception:
   229	        raise Invalid('AAAA data')
   230	    return address.compressed
   231	
   232	
   233	def canon_txt_data(value):
   234	    if type(value) is not str:
   235	        raise Invalid('TXT data type')
   236	    if len(value) > MAX_TXT:
   237	        raise Invalid('TXT length')
   238	    for char in value:
   239	        code = ord(char)
   240	        if code < 0x20 or code > 0x7E:
   241	            raise Invalid('TXT character')
   242	    return value

   245	def canon_record(value):
   246	    exact_keys(value, ('owner', 'type', 'data'))
   247	    owner = canon_name(value['owner'])
   248	    rtype = value['type']
   249	    if type(rtype) is not str or rtype not in TYPES:
   250	        raise Invalid('record type')
   251	    data = value['data']
   252	    if rtype == 'A':
   253	        rdata = canon_a_data(data)
   254	    elif rtype == 'AAAA':
   255	        rdata = canon_aaaa_data(data)
   256	    elif rtype == 'TXT':
   257	        rdata = canon_txt_data(data)
   258	    else:
   259	        rdata = canon_name(data)
   260	    return owner, rtype, rdata

   263	def check_id(value):
   264	    if type(value) is not str:
   265	        raise Invalid('id type')
   266	    size = len(value)
   267	    if size < 1 or size > MAX_ID:
   268	        raise Invalid('id length')
   269	    for char in value:
   270	        if char not in _ID_CHARS:
   271	            raise Invalid('id character')
   272	    return value

   277	class Zone:
   278	    __slots__ = ('origin', 'nlabels', 'rrsets', 'existing')
   279	
   280	    def __init__(self, origin, rrsets):
   281	        self.origin = origin
   282	        self.nlabels = label_count(origin)
   283	        self.rrsets = rrsets
   284	        existing = {origin}
   285	        for owner in rrsets:
   286	            name = owner
   287	            while name != origin:
   288	                existing.add(name)
   289	                name = parent_name(name)
   290	        self.existing = existing
   291	
   292	    def matches(self, name):
   293	        return is_at_or_below(name, self.origin)
   294	
   295	    def closest_encloser(self, name):
   296	        existing = self.existing
   297	        current = name
   298	        while True:
   299	            current = parent_name(current)
   300	            if current in existing:
   301	                return current
   302	            if current == '.':
   303	                return None
   304	
   305	    def wildcard_of(self, encloser):
   306	        return '*.' if encloser == '.' else '*.' + encloser
